sentences.en: Peace-keeping troops moved in to restore calm after the battle.
sentences.zh: 维和部队在战斗结束后进驻以恢复平静。

sentences.en: Troops were swiftly called in to put down the riot.
sentences.zh: 军队迅速被调来镇压骚乱。

sentences.en: The United Nations sent troops to intervene in the conflict.
sentences.zh: 联合国派遣军队介入冲突。
